zh-CN.title: 分类操作与本地化问题修复

sections.title: 问题修复
items: 修复添加分类、重命名、删除和导入确认等弹窗按钮点击无响应的问题
修复英文界面下命令名称、说明和自定义分类中的中文被误翻译的问题

zh-CN.notice: 更新安装完成后需要重启 Tabby 才会生效。

en.title: Category actions and localization fixes

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fix unresponsive buttons in add category, rename, delete, import confirmation, and other dialogs
Prevent Chinese text in command names, descriptions, and custom categories from being translated in the English interface

en.notice: Restart Tabby after installation to apply the update.
